output.reason: [ev-4c2676e4665a] says only that ZooKeeper-based clusters and ZooKeeper-to-KRaft migration are no longer supported, and that every cluster must use KRaft before the upgrade. Neither that item nor the rest of the section context names a field, annotation or setting that marks a cluster as ZooKeeper-based. An undecidable leaf is therefore justified, but the proposed reason "environment-visibility-gap" is not an allowed reason. It also describes config visibility, which the engine handles itself. The right reason is evidence-gap. P4's gvk-in-use Kafka would be too broad, because it would also flag KRaft clusters.
